name: better-sqlite3
description: Local shim: drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3 does `import Client from 'better-sqlite3'` at module load. Tiangong's S1 migration replaces better-sqlite3 with the built-in node:sqlite (DatabaseSync) via api/lib/node-sqlite-adapter.ts, so the default Client constructor is never invoked. This shim exists only to satisfy the import statement and is gitignored (node_modules/).
